purpose: Teach: 辞める/肩書き/党内/プロダクト/親会社/やりがい/チャネル/紛失

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、辞める、絶対、社員、絶対、減らす策、絶対、考えましょう
lines.en: We need to seriously consider a concrete plan to retain our staff.
lines.style: Clear, measured tone. Deliberate pacing on each key point. Alert posture — this is a directive, not casual. Slight forward lean on 'seriously,' grounding the stakes.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、肩書き、絶対、シンプル化、絶対、検討中です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're actively reviewing how to streamline our title structure. Thank you for bringing this.
lines.style: Attentive, responsive. Slightly faster pace than yuki — eager to show alignment. Warm but professional. Light emphasis on 'actively reviewing' to signal commitment.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界団体、本気で、絶対、党内、絶対、人事、絶対、確認しましょう
lines.en: We should also verify our HR practices align with industry standards.
lines.style: Steady, methodical. Building on the previous point without rushing. Slight upward inflection on 'verify' — this is a genuine question embedded in direction, not blind instruction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、プロダクト、絶対、改良、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're actively advancing our product improvements. I appreciate your guidance on this.
lines.style: Assured, slightly quicker tempo. Confident without being overconfident. Lands 'advancing' firmly. Closes with genuine warmth on the gratitude — this person knows when to acknowledge leadership.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、親会社、絶対、と、絶対、連携、絶対、強化しましょう
lines.en: Let's strengthen our coordination with the parent company on this.
lines.style: Steady, strategic. Measured delivery — this is important but not panicked. Slight pause before 'parent company,' indicating this requires careful handling. Grounded authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、本気で、絶対、やりがい、絶対、調査、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've completed our survey on employee satisfaction and fulfillment. I'm grateful for the opportunity to report this.
lines.style: Warm, relieved undertone. Slightly slower on 'completed' — small pride in the accomplishment. Genuine on the closing gratitude. Not performative, but honestly present.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新販売、本気で、絶対、チャネル、絶対、契約、絶対、進めましょう
lines.en: We should move forward with expanding our sales channels.
lines.style: Directive, forward-momentum. Crisp attack on the opening. Brisk but not rushed. This is the next step, and it's clear. Minimal trailing — efficiency in every syllable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、紛失、絶対、トラブル、絶対、再発防止、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've implemented thorough recurrence prevention for any loss or trouble incidents. Thank you for your leadership.
lines.style: Professional closure. Slightly slower on 'thorough' — emphasizing due diligence. Calm and assured. Warm but formal on the closing gratitude — this is respect, not familiarity. Settling tone.
